definitions.explanation: A person who appreciates and seeks out high-quality or delicious food.
High-quality or specialty food and dining. Often used as a modifier to describe food-related things.

examples.japanese: グルメな⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦お{店|みせ}→お店：21164_omise⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: A foodie friend recommended a restaurant to me.

notes:
グルメ comes from French "gourmet" and is used both as a noun (a food lover) and as a na-adjective/modifier (gourmet, food-related).

USAGE:
- グルメな + noun: a gourmet ~, food-loving ~
- グルメ + noun (compound): gourmet ~, food ~
In Japanese, グルメ is used much more broadly than in English. It refers not just to a connoisseur but also casually to anyone who enjoys good food, similar to "foodie." B⟦{級|きゅう}→級：28171_kyuu⟧グルメ in particular refers to inexpensive local comfort food, not fine dining.

COMPOUNDS:
- グルメ⟦{番組|ばんぐみ}→番組：01705_bangumi⟧: food/gourmet TV show
- グルメ⟦サイト→サイト：05603_saito⟧: restaurant review site
- グルメ⟦スポット→スポット：11578_supotto⟧: gourmet spot, foodie destination
- B⟦{級|きゅう}→級：28171_kyuu⟧グルメ: budget gourmet, cheap but delicious food
- ご{当地|とうち}グルメ: local specialty cuisine
